speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you have been experiencing a headache and worsening vision over the past three weeks. To help me understand your condition, can you describe exactly what the headache feels like and where it is located?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri).

Based on the 69-year-old female demographic with progressive headache and worsening vision over three weeks, and the absence of fever or weight loss, I am concerned about increased intracranial pressure. To confirm this, I need to see your fundoscopic examination results immediately. REQUEST IMAGES: Fundoscopy.
